correctness.rationale: For a regular attracting prime-two orbit, the both-plus itinerary has expanding multiplier, the both-minus itinerary is expanding or impossible by a short-arc integer displacement bound, hence the orbit must be mixed. Its affine lift difference forces an integer in {1,2}, yielding an exhaustive pair of orbit parameterizations. The mixed multiplier \(4(1-b^2)\) is below one precisely for \(b>\sqrt3/2\); strict endpoint inequalities give the two disjoint strips. At equality \(pq=1\), both surviving parameter values give intervals on which the two-step map is exactly identity. Exact integration gives the positive area; symbolic identities and fifty rational tests were run from the attached checker. Breakpoint cycles are explicitly outside the theorem.
